hedging_summary.note: Pre-production exploration stage company. No commodity hedging instruments as the company has no proved reserves or commercial production. No material financial assets or liabilities accounted for at fair value on a recurring basis as of June 30, 2025.

production.note: Exploration stage company with no commercial production. Activities in the Beetaloo Basin, Northern Territory, Australia. BUG (Beneficial Use of Gas) approval received September 2025 to sell appraisal gas from Shenandoah South Pilot Project. Target first gas sales of up to 40 TJ/d under NTGGSA commencing mid-2026.

reserves.note: All of the Group's exploration and evaluation projects are pending the determination of proven or probable reserves. Total proved reserves were nil as of June 30, 2025 and 2024.

economics.note: No standardized measure or PV-10 calculated as proved reserves are nil.

metadata.notes: Tamboran is an exploration-stage natural gas company focused on the Beetaloo Basin, Northern Territory, Australia. FY ends June 30. Development spending significantly accelerated in FY2025 ($132.5MM vs $74.0MM in FY2024). Capitalized unproved properties grew from $230MM to $342MM. Assets under construction for gas equipment grew from $7.5MM to $24.4MM. Sand mining permits added. Checkerboard Strategy with DWE restructured -- Company to retain ~1.9MM net prospective acres. Phase 2 Development Area (406,693 gross acres) with planned farm-down. BUG approval received Sep 2025. First gas sales targeted mid-2026 at up to 40 TJ/d (39 MMcf/d). ORRI of 2.34358% to Daly Waters Royalty. Uses successful efforts accounting under ASC 932.
